children: PMV Pharmaceuticals reported a 46% overall response rate in the ovarian cancer cohort and plans an NDA submission in Q1 2027.
46% ORR (35/76 evaluable patients) in ovarian cohort; includes four CRs and 29 confirmed PRs.
Median duration of response 10.0 months; median time to response 1.3 months (confirmed responses).
Favorable safety profile with mostly Grade 1–2 treatment-related AEs and 5% discontinuation rate.
FDA feedback supports accelerated-approval NDA strategy for platinum-resistant/refractory ovarian cancer.
Company to present full PYNNACLE Phase 2 cohort updates at a medical conference in Q4 2026.
